name: Santorini, Greece
description: Iconic white-washed buildings with blue domes perched on volcanic cliffs above the stunning Aegean Sea.

name: Machu Picchu, Peru
description: Ancient Incan citadel set high in the Andes Mountains, surrounded by breathtaking cloud-draped peaks.

name: Aurora Borealis, Iceland
description: Nature's greatest light show — vivid green and purple curtains of light dancing across the Arctic night sky.

name: Amalfi Coast, Italy
description: Dramatic coastal cliffs lined with colorful villages, lemon groves, and sparkling Mediterranean waters.

name: Bali, Indonesia
description: Tropical paradise known for terraced rice fields, ancient Hindu temples, and lush jungle landscapes.

name: Grand Canyon, USA
description: A colossal natural wonder carved by the Colorado River — one of the most awe-inspiring landscapes on Earth.

name: Maldives
description: Crystal-clear turquoise lagoons, overwater bungalows, and pristine coral reefs in the heart of the Indian Ocean.

name: Patagonia, Argentina
description: Untamed wilderness at the end of the world — dramatic glaciers, jagged peaks, and vast open steppes.

name: Kyoto, Japan
description: Ancient imperial capital with thousands of temples, golden pavilions, and stunning cherry blossom gardens.

name: Banff National Park, Canada
description: Turquoise glacier-fed lakes, soaring Rocky Mountain peaks, and abundant wildlife in Canada's oldest national park.

name: Positano, Italy
description: A fairytale cliffside village cascading down to the sea, bursting with bougainvillea and Mediterranean charm.

name: Zhangjiajie, China
description: Towering sandstone pillars draped in mist, inspiring the floating mountains of the movie Avatar.

name: Fjords of Norway
description: Deep, dramatic glacial inlets flanked by towering cliffs and cascading waterfalls in the Norwegian wilderness.

name: Sahara Desert, Morocco
description: An endless sea of golden sand dunes stretching to the horizon, magical under the vast starlit desert sky.

name: Venice, Italy
description: A unique floating city built on canals, with ornate Gothic architecture and timeless romantic atmosphere.

name: Plitvice Lakes, Croatia
description: A series of sixteen terraced lakes connected by waterfalls flowing through lush forest in vivid shades of blue.

name: Cappadocia, Turkey
description: Surreal landscape of fairy chimneys and cave dwellings, best experienced from a hot air balloon at sunrise.

name: Great Barrier Reef, Australia
description: The world's largest coral reef system, home to thousands of marine species in spectacular underwater color.

name: Swiss Alps, Switzerland
description: Majestic snow-capped peaks, charming alpine villages, and pristine meadows — the crown of Europe.

name: Amazon Rainforest, Brazil
description: The world's largest tropical rainforest, teeming with extraordinary biodiversity and ancient indigenous culture.

name: Ha Long Bay, Vietnam
description: Thousands of limestone karst islands rising dramatically from emerald green waters in the Gulf of Tonkin.

name: Petra, Jordan
description: The rose-red ancient city carved directly into cliff faces, a UNESCO World Heritage and wonder of the world.

name: Serengeti, Tanzania
description: Witness the greatest wildlife spectacle on Earth — millions of animals migrating across endless golden savanna.

name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
description: The largest religious monument in the world — a magnificent 12th-century temple complex deep in the jungle.

name: Pamukkale, Turkey
description: Stunning natural terraces of pure white calcium carbonate filled with warm turquoise thermal pools.

name: Niagara Falls, Canada/USA
description: One of the most powerful and awe-inspiring waterfalls on Earth, straddling the US-Canada border.

name: Tuscany, Italy
description: Rolling golden hills dotted with cypress trees, medieval hilltop towns, and world-renowned vineyards.

name: Antelope Canyon, USA
description: A breathtaking slot canyon carved by water into flowing red sandstone waves and beams of light.

name: Raja Ampat, Indonesia
description: Remote island archipelago with the highest marine biodiversity on Earth and stunning above-water scenery.

name: Lofoten Islands, Norway
description: Dramatic red fishing villages nestled beneath jagged Arctic peaks, reflected in still mirror-like fjord waters.
